description: Change settings of one of your Besidka projects: rename it, pin or archive it, set the knowledge mode, turn project memory on or off, choose whether it also uses account memory, or set automatic memory updates to inherit (follow your account setting, not allowed while they are off for the project) or off. Automatic updates cannot be turned on, or back from off, here, only in the app, and project memory cannot be turned back on here while its automatic updates are on. Each field is set to the value you send, never toggled. Turning memory on again restores its state and covers messages written from now on; it does not read earlier chats or call a model (use Refresh in the app to include earlier chats). If a call fails partway, the fields before the failing one are already applied, in the order name, pinned, archived, knowledgeMode, useAccountMemory, memoryAutoUpdate, memoryEnabled. Send at least one field besides projectId. Requires signing in (projects:write).

archived.description: true archives the project, false restores it

knowledgeMode.description: How chats use the knowledge: auto, full or search

memoryAutoUpdate.description: inherit follows your account setting for automatic memory updates (refused while the project is set to off, which can only be changed in the Besidka app), off stops automatic updates for this project. on is not available here: it makes Besidka spend your own API key in the background, so it can only be turned on in the Besidka app

memoryEnabled.description: true turns project memory on (refused while it is off and automatic updates are on for the project, which can only be resumed in the Besidka app), false turns it off

pinned.description: true pins the project, false unpins it

useAccountMemory.description: Whether chats in the project also use your account memory

name: update_project
title: Update a project
